title: The World between Empires: Art and Identity in the Ancient Middle East — Judaea
creator: The Metropolitan Museum of Art
provenance: Metropolitan Museum scholarly catalogue contextualizing the Roman response to the Judaean revolt, the 70 CE siege of Jerusalem, destruction of the Temple, and Josephus as a critical ancient source.
notes: Useful independent modern synthesis alongside the near-contemporary Josephus account.
Also describes the later Arch of Titus as commemoration of the Flavian victory and Temple spoils.
